CODE_semantics: Exact frozen la,ld,nf,nd,ns,ent values; no labels/proxies injected; no new feature derivation

PROCESS_semantics.aggregation_semantics: Inherited ApacheJIT numeric aggregates; no future/target data added
PROCESS_semantics.ancestor_scope: Inherited frozen source history; not reconstructed
PROCESS_semantics.event_cutoff: Historical source commit event; no new cutoff computed
PROCESS_semantics.proof_limit: Exact historical aggregation details not independently recreated in this stage; unresolved details remain Q1 limitations, not invented proof

TEXT_semantics: Frozen raw message and exact fitted vectorizer; no issue metadata or target-based filtering; exact vocabulary/IDF/order/parameters required
matrix_recipe: Apply pipeline[:-1].transform to existing frozen raw rows twice. Do not call full pipeline.transform or any predictor. Preserve output dtype, CSR representation for sparse output, exact order and values.
numerical_equivalence: Exact repeated array/CSR equality only, no tolerance fallback. No historical transformed-X reference exists; repeat equality is not historical equality.
row_order: Existing source row order, no reselection
scope_selection: All eligible scopes audited; only the one already proven source is materialized, no outcome-based fallback
storage: Content-addressed canonical JSON arrays, including CSR data/indices/indptr; shared only when full matrix identity agrees. No model bytes copied. 80*2557*8*4 upper-bound dense TEXT ~6.6MB binary; JSON estimate below25MB per matrix. Hard25MB per output guard.
